--- HB-62 §1 | Memo: flight fare limit exceptions — Purpose | version: 1 · status: current · effective: 2025-03-01
This memo lists group exceptions to the flight fare limit in HB-56. The travel office publishes worked examples of the flight fare limit on the intranet. Each claim for the flight fare limit needs a receipt showing the date, the amount and the supplier.
--- HB-62 §2 | Memo: flight fare limit exceptions — Exception for intercontinental flights | version: 1 · status: current · effective: 2025-03-01
For intercontinental flights, the flight fare limit is 800 EUR per return flight instead of the standard amount. Claims for the flight fare limit are filed in the expense tool under 'Travel policy: flights'. The travel office publishes worked examples of the flight fare limit on the intranet.
--- HB-62 §3 | Memo: flight fare limit exceptions — Carve-out | version: 1 · status: current · effective: 2025-03-01
The exception above does not apply to flights booked by contractors; they follow the standard flight fare limit in HB-56 §2. Each claim for the flight fare limit needs a receipt showing the date, the amount and the supplier. The travel office reviews the flight fare limit once a year and announces changes in advance.
--- HB-46 §1 | Memo: home-office equipment allowance exceptions — Purpose | version: 1 · status: current · effective: 2025-03-01
This memo lists group exceptions to the home-office equipment allowance in HB-63. The facilities publishes worked examples of the home-office equipment allowance on the intranet. Questions about the home-office equipment allowance go to the facilities, who keeps the record of decisions.
--- HB-46 §2 | Memo: home-office equipment allowance exceptions — Exception for employees with a medical accessibility plan | version: 1 · status: current · effective: 2025-03-01
For employees with a medical accessibility plan, the home-office equipment allowance is 600 EUR instead of the standard amount. Questions about the home-office equipment allowance go to the facilities, who keeps the record of decisions. The facilities publishes worked examples of the home-office equipment allowance on the intranet.
--- HB-46 §3 | Memo: home-office equipment allowance exceptions — Carve-out | version: 1 · status: current · effective: 2025-03-01
The exception above does not apply to part-time employees working fewer than 20 hours a week; they follow the standard home-office equipment allowance in HB-63 §2. Managers confirm claims for the home-office equipment allowance before payment in the next payroll run. The facilities reviews the home-office equipment allowance once a year and announces changes in advance.
